headline: Brazil September Factory Output Falls 2.5% Year-on-Year
summary: Brazil's industrial production declined 2.5% in September compared to the previous year and dropped 0.8% from August, missing forecasts.
why: Industrial production data measures manufacturing sector health and broader economic activity trends in South America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Weak manufacturing output signals slowing domestic industrial activity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Worse-than-expected industrial contraction points to a slowdown in Brazil's manufacturing sector.
